stem.text: Nitrogen dioxide decomposes on heating according to the equation shown.
When $4\,\text{mol}$ of nitrogen dioxide were put into a $1\,\text{dm}^{3}$ container and heated to a constant temperature, the equilibrium mixture contained $0.8\,\text{mol}$ of oxygen.
What is the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_\text{c}$, at the temperature of the experiment?
